Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent hallucinated specific names and relationships in its search results. The search query was for "Alexandre Berthier, 3rd Prince of Wagram," but the text it reported containing ("His father, Jacques Berthier... his grandfather, Henri Berthier") is factually incorrect regarding the specific title "3rd Prince of Wagram." The famous "Louis Alexandre Berthier, 1st Prince of Wagram" (Napoleon's chief of staff) is the ancestor in question, not a "3rd" Prince. The WebSurfer failed to distinguish between the 1st Prince (Louis Alexandre) and a potentially non-existent or confused "3rd" designation, leading it to invent or misattribute family members (Jacques and Henri) instead of correctly identifying the lineage of the actual historical figure. The correct paternal grandfather of Louis Alexandre Berthier (1st Prince) is Jean-Baptiste Berthier (often referred to as the Duke of Valençay), and his father was Louis Alexandre Berthier's own father, but the confusion stems from the agent's failure to retrieve accurate data, resulting in the wrong names (Henri/Jacques) being presented as facts.
